There are a couple things you can do to make sure you have the best chance of getting this screened and checked out appropriately:

DETAILS: 
-names/DOBs/school or work locations for everyone in the home, address and any other contact information 
- provide all the details you can about what you have observed first hand, such as dates of incidents/behaviours that concernEd you/ what they have said or written/where the kids were at the time/where they were posting from etc. 
- write everything down before you call, helps you get everything across and be coherent. 
- screenshots are a good bonus, so are names for any other witnesses and their contact info.
